newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to name Romer new Democratic Party head.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to name Romer new Democratic Party head.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton is expected to name Colorado Governor Roy Romer as the new chairman of the Democratic National Committee on Tuesday or Wednesday, a White House official said.

"He's very well respected. He's close to the president and he's prepared to take on responsibility for dealing with campaign finance reform which will be a top item on his agenda," the official said late on Monday.
Campaign financing become a major issue for Clinton and the Democratic Party as a result of improper contributions received during the 1996 campaign.

Romer and Clinton have been friends since Clinton's days as the governor of Arkansas. The Coloradan was often rumoured as a possible Clinton cabinet member, but he had said he wanted to finish his term as governor.

Amy Weiss Tobe, spokeswoman for the Democratic National Committee, said the full DNC would vote on Clinton's picks for the elected DNC offices at its meeting on Jan. 21, the day after Clinton is sworn in for his second term.
